mission: Trigger-6 external source audit, architecture mapping and deterministic falsification of F2 target-host identity/profile completion binding without duplicating Trigger-4 implementation.
external_primary_sources: systemd/systemd@048970650ce5d50bceffff97442c4a90c1cf0572: machine-id, app-specific machine identity, boot identity, login/session inspection
verified_research_findings: Raw /etc/machine-id must not be persisted/exported as the F2 host identity; systemd treats it as confidential and provides application-specific derived identity semantics.
Stable host lineage, boot epoch, service invocation and login/session are distinct identity scopes; one snapshot digest should not stand in for all of them.
WP1201 G1 is a strong bounded source component: fixed privacy allow-list, deterministic profile digest, explicit UNKNOWN, bounded read-only probes, no runtime/completion credit.
WP1201 G1 hashes the entire fact map in one global profile digest, mixing platform, software, device, session and runtime facts.

Independent synthetic reconstruction of the observed digest contract changed the global digest in 7/7 single-fact perturbations; candidate requirement-scoped bindings changed only on selected relevant fields in the same matrix.
The observed G1 schema has no host_scope_id and no boot_scope_id.
Successful dynamic command stdout is retained as raw fact text; volatile runtime topology should be separated or minimally parsed before use as stable host fingerprint material.
architecture_candidate: Preserve WP1201 whole-snapshot digest for provenance, but add a successor split: application-specific HostScopeIdentity, BootScopeIdentity, independently digested HostProfileComponents / volatile HostRuntimeWitnesses, and exact RequirementBindingDigest values over only required components. UNKNOWN debt should be requirement-local rather than globally blocking unrelated obligations.
counterhypothesis: Monolithic invalidation is simpler and maximally conservative. Component/requirement binding is acceptable only if an E4 ablation proves lower irrelevant revalidation with zero false-preserve cases for requirement-relevant changes.

coordination.reason: Do not duplicate or mutate Trigger-4-owned active generation before terminal reconciliation.

next_exact_gate: After WP1201 G1 terminal reconciliation or an explicit non-overlapping successor claim, run E4 F2 ablation comparing monolithic versus requirement-scoped binding on controlled audio/browser/USB/reboot/kernel/permission/platform changes. Promote only with zero requirement-relevant false-preserve cases and a measured reduction in irrelevant invalidation. Then bind the first read-only physical target bundle without minting whole-host completion from collection alone.
